newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Eleven S.Korean firms approved for October IPO.
newsitem.headline: Eleven S.Korean firms approved for October IPO.

text.p: South Korea's Securities and Exchange Commission has approved plans for initial public offerings (IPO) by Kohap Petrochemical Corp and 10 other firms in October, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Friday.
The companies will hold their offerings on October 7 and 8, and will publicly list their shares sometime in November, a statement from the board said.
The application by First Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd to offer 1.96 million shares at 9,000 won per share was postponed. The Securities Supervisory Board (SSB) gave no details.
Details about IPOs by the 11 firms are as follows:
Kohap, a chemical product and synthetic fibre maker, will offer 3.86 million shares at 10,500 won each.
Dong Won Fisheries Co Ltd, South Korea's largest fishery, will offer 600,000 shares at 11,000 won each.
Korea Technology Banking Corp, an investment and short-term finance firm, will offer six million shares at 9,000 won a share.
Hanmi Leasing Co, a short-term finance firm, plans to offer 3.44 million shares at 6,500 won per share.
Hanil Leasing Co, a short-term finance firm, will offer 4.3 million shares at 7,500 won each.
Mirae Corp, a semiconductor inspection equipment maker, will offer 380,000 shares at 40,000 won each.
Wooshin Industries Co Ltd, a PVC producer, will offer 260,000 shares at 20,000 won.
Dongyang Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd will offer 939,682 shares at 6,300 won each.
Seoul Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd will offer 640,000 shares at 7,500 won.
Daeyang Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd will offer 738,571 shares at 14,000 won each.
Dong-A Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd plans to offer 720,000 shares at 8,000 won per share.
